subtitle: Your PDF tools. Locally on your computer.
available: {count} of {total} tools available · Missing tools are greyed out.
install: Required tool: {tool}. Install it and reopen this function.
wait: Please wait until the current operation finishes.
output: Output file (existing files will not be overwritten)
order_note: The displayed order is used. Use Reorder PDF pages afterwards to change the order. For two files: A first, B second.
download_note: GitHub raw source for mintPDF (no project source configured yet). Existing files are preserved. Downloads continue after closing this dialog while mintPDF remains open.
note_compare: Visual comparison: A and B are placed side by side in a new PDF. No automatic change highlighting.
note_redact: Redacts all matches of the entered searchable text and removes their content. Use OCR first for scanned images. Review the result before sharing.
note_compress: Ghostscript writes a new PDF. Image quality and size depend on the profile; the output is not always smaller.
note_convert: Converts a document supported by LibreOffice to PDF.
E_INPUT: E_INPUT: Invalid input. Check file types, count, page range, angle and text length. Outputs require .pdf, image/page exports .zip. No output was saved.
E_DEP: E_DEP: Tool missing or cannot be loaded. Install the dependency listed in the menu; restart mintPDF for Python libraries.
E_EXISTS: E_EXISTS: Output already exists. Choose a new filename. Existing data is preserved.
E_PASSWORD: E_PASSWORD: Password missing or incorrect. Enter the correct document password.
E_TOOL: E_TOOL: The tool could not finish. Check the input document and tool; no completed output was saved.
E_FILE: E_FILE: File could not be processed. Check file, format, free space and permissions. Details are in logs/mintpdf.log.
E_NO_IMAGES: E_NO_IMAGES: No embedded images found. Use PDF to images instead.
E_NO_MATCH: E_NO_MATCH: No matching text found. Check spelling; scanned pages need OCR first.
E_LANG: E_LANG: Invalid language file. Repair the UTF-8 JSON object with text keys and string values. The file is ignored until fixed.
E_CONFIG: E_CONFIG: Invalid settings. Check config/settings.json; defaults are used temporarily.
E_HELP: E_HELP: Help missing or invalid. Restore help/<language code>.html. Select a tool, inputs and a new output path; missing dependencies are listed in the menu.
E_ICON: E_ICON: Image missing or damaged. Restore resources; a fallback icon is shown until then.
E_DOWNLOAD: E_DOWNLOAD: Download failed or content invalid. Check the mintPDF GitHub source, language code, network, downloads folder and permissions. Existing files are preserved.
E_START: E_START: Application entry point missing. Restore the complete application package.
merge_order_note: Arrange files from top to bottom. Select at least two PDFs, then click Finish to merge them.
output_folder_note: Default output folder for new files. Saved together with the other settings.
split_zip_note: The parts are saved as individual PDFs in a ZIP archive. The original is preserved.
split_ranges: Custom page ranges – one PDF per range
E_SPLIT: E_SPLIT: Invalid split. Chunk size must be at least 1. Cut positions must be ascending and before the final page (e.g. 2,5). Separate custom ranges with semicolons (e.g. 1-3; 4-6). Use existing page numbers only. No output is created until corrected.
E_OUTPUT_DIR: E_OUTPUT_DIR: Output folder is invalid or not writable. Choose an existing folder with an absolute path and write permission. The previous setting is preserved.
choose_two: Please select exactly two PDF files.
engine_optimize: PyMuPDF optimizes the PDF structure without image downsampling or OCR. Use Compress PDF for smaller images and Recognize text with OCR for scans.
ocr_options_note: Deskew is disabled when redoing OCR. Optimization 2/3 may require additional tools such as pngquant. Force-rasterizing every page is not offered.
E_OPTIONS: E_OPTIONS: Invalid tool options. Choose a supported profile, OCR mode, format or resolution. Do not combine deskew with redo OCR. No output was saved.
E_OCR_LANGUAGE: E_OCR_LANGUAGE: OCR language pack missing. Install Tesseract and the required language pack (e.g. tesseract-ocr-deu or tesseract-ocr-eng), then reopen this tool. No output was saved.
E_LOG: E_LOG: Cannot read or write the log. Check logs/mintpdf.log and its permissions. Logging falls back to standard error when writing fails.
ed_selected_font: Original font: {font}. This span is replaced using the selected font.
ed_applied: Change applied. Choose Save as to write the PDF.
ed_unsaved_detail: Discard changes? To save, cancel and choose Save as.
ed_hint_select_text: Click a text span. Change text, font, size and color, then Apply. Scans contain no selectable text.
ed_hint_new_text: Drag a text rectangle on the page, enter text and properties, then Apply.
ed_hint_select_image: Click an image. Drag to move or edit position, width and height. Apply commits the change.
ed_hint_new_image: Choose an image, drag its destination rectangle on the page and Apply.
ed_hint_line: Drag the line area, choose color and width, then Apply.
ed_hint_circle: Drag an ellipse area and Apply. Use equal width and height for a circle.
ed_hint_freehand: Draw while holding the mouse button, then Apply.
ed_hint_highlight: Drag across existing text, choose a highlight color and Apply.
ed_hint_note: Click the page for a new note, or click an existing note to edit. Enter text and Apply.
ed_hint_link: Drag a new link area or click an existing link. Enter an https://, http:// or mailto: address and Apply.
ed_hint_crop: Drag the visible area of this page and Apply. Content outside is hidden, not deleted.
E_EDIT_RECT: E_EDIT_RECT: The area must be inside the page with positive width and height.
E_EDIT_SELECT: E_EDIT_SELECT: First select a matching object on the page or choose an image file.
E_EDIT_FIT: E_EDIT_FIT: Text does not fit. Enlarge the box, reduce the font size or shorten the text. Nothing was changed.
E_EDIT_GLYPH: E_EDIT_GLYPH: The font does not contain every character. Choose a suitable font, such as DejaVu.
E_EDIT_COMPLEX: E_EDIT_COMPLEX: Overlapping or rotated objects, or pending redactions, prevent safe editing. Nothing was changed. Select a simple individual object.
E_EDIT_LINK: E_EDIT_LINK: Enter an https://, http:// or mailto: link address.
E_EDITOR: E_EDITOR: Open Edit PDF in the graphical interface.
E_EDIT_TEXT: E_EDIT_TEXT: The text field is empty. Enter text in the white field on the right, for example X for a checkbox, then choose Apply. Nothing was changed.
E_EDIT_SIZE: E_EDIT_SIZE: Choose a font size between 1 and 300 pt. Nothing was changed.
ed_text_input: Enter text here (e.g. X for a checkbox)
form_existing: Already fillable: {text} text fields and {checkbox} selection fields on {pages} pages. Existing fields are preserved without duplicates.
form_detected: Detected automatically: {text} text fields and {checkbox} checkboxes on {pages} pages. A fillable PDF can be created.
form_partial: No reliable input areas were found on page(s) {pages}. No new fields will be added there.
form_note: The layout and original file are preserved. Open the result in a PDF viewer (e.g. Xreader) and check the fields. Detection only adds clear boxes and input lines; completeness is not guaranteed. New checkboxes are independent.
E_FORM_NONE: E_FORM_NONE: No reliably recognizable form template found. Existing fields, clearly labelled boxes and input lines can be detected. Scans and unclear layouts require manual form creation; no file was created.
E_FORM_INVALID: E_FORM_INVALID: The PDF contains form objects without a valid form structure. Repair it in a PDF form application and try again. No file was created.
decrypt_locked: Encrypted – a password is required to open this PDF. Enter the opening or owner password. This protection cannot be bypassed without a valid password.
decrypt_restricted: Encrypted but readable without an opening password. Owner protection and permission restrictions can be removed.
decrypt_plain: This PDF is not encrypted. There is no password protection to remove. Finish saves a copy of the unchanged contents.
decrypt_without: Only restrictions on the already readable PDF are removed without a password. The original file is preserved.
rd_hint: Drag to mark areas. Undo/Redo adjusts the selection. Redact and save permanently removes contents from a new PDF.
rd_unsaved: Marked areas have not been saved. Discard the marks?
E_REDACT_AREA: E_REDACT_AREA: Mark at least one valid area within a PDF page. No file was created.
opt_analysis:
Analysis: {pages} pages · {size:.2f} MiB
{images} images · {fonts} fonts ({full_fonts} fully embedded)
{uncompressed} uncompressed streams
{widgets} form fields · {annotations} annotations · {attachments} attachments
opt_fonts: Reduce embedded fonts to used characters
opt_unavailable: Not present or not applicable in this PDF.
opt_note: Unavailable options are greyed out. Page appearance is preserved; images are not resized. Already compressed data may not shrink further. A smaller file is not guaranteed. Document information and attachments are kept unless their removal is selected.
workflow_stopped: Workflow cancelled. The last PDF remains available:
workflow_note: Add functions and arrange their order. Functions may be added more than once. Each step opens its options and saves a new PDF, which is automatically used in the next step. Choose encryption last. External editors, visual redaction, ZIP exports and functions requiring multiple inputs run separately.
cmp_unchanged: No differences in the selected mode
cmp_legend: Red: regions in PDF 1. Blue: regions in PDF 2.
cmp_method: Counting: contiguous word-change blocks and connected 24-pixel grid regions at 96 dpi (colour tolerance 12/255). Added/deleted pages are counted separately. Identical pages serve as anchors; remaining pages are paired using text similarity and order within each section. Check alignment for heavily restructured documents. Text mode does not perform OCR; scanned text can only be checked visually. Technical mode checks selected properties: page size, rotation, fonts, image count, links, form fields, annotations, metadata, bookmarks, attachments and permissions. It is not a complete comparison of all PDF objects.
description_crop: Crop PDF pages with a visible crop rectangle
keywords_crop: crop zuschneiden trim margins ränder seiten
description_images_pdf: Insert an image or visible signature with selection frame, mouse positioning and resizing.
keywords_ocr: ocr text erkennen scan recognition durchsuchbar
description_text_extract: Save PDF text as a UTF-8 text file. Run OCR first for scanned pages.
description_convert: Convert PDF to TXT, HTML, ODT, PNG or JPG.
tool_optional: Optional – required only for specific functions.
info_pymupdf: Internal PDF tools; provide locally using setup_dependencies.sh. No APT package assumed.
info_cairo: Preview for comparison, cropping and visual redaction.
info_gs: PDF compression; also required by some OCR PDF/A output paths.
info_ocr: OCR requires OCRmyPDF, Tesseract and matching language data.
info_web: Webpage to PDF; not available in all APT repositories.
crop_note: Drag a rectangle around the area to keep, or change the margins. The shaded area will be hidden.
crop_limits: Cropping limits the visible page area. Content outside remains in the PDF; use PDF redaction to remove confidential content.
crop_all: Apply this frame to all pages
crop_status: Page {page}/{total} · {count} page(s) cropped · Kept area: {width:.1f} × {height:.1f} mm
crop_invalid: Margins leave no valid page area.
layout_note: Select the PDF first, then images. Preview shows existing PDF content and all inserted images. Set target page, position and width. Inspect each image using the page menu; save a new PDF from File. Drag the blue outlined image to move it; millimetre values update automatically. Drag any of the four corner handles to resize proportionally.
layout_invalid: The image must fit entirely inside the page. Adjust position or width.
choose_background_pdf: Select the PDF to insert images into
extract_note: Tick the images to extract. File → Save stores only selected images in a ZIP file. Reused images appear once with all page references. These are embedded images, not complete PDF pages.
existing_note: Click an existing PDF image or select it using the page menu. Drag to move; drag corner handles to resize. Alternatively enter millimetre values. File → Save creates a new PDF. Click blank space to deselect. Changing pages only changes the viewed PDF page; it does not move images. Edit offers rotate image left/right.
E_IMAGE_COMPLEX: This PDF contains overlapping, rotated or complex embedded images, or pending redactions. Safe image editing is unavailable; use Edit PDF.
E_IMAGE_GUI: Open Resize and move PDF images in the graphical PDF preview.
existing_select: Page {page}/{total} · Click an image to select it.
image_rotate_fit: The rotated image does not fit on the page. Resize it first.
image_crop_note: Click an image and drag a frame around the area to retain. Shaded margins are cropped. Edit → Apply image crop or File → Save. A new PDF is created. Adjust green corner/edge handles or move the selection from inside. Margin values allow millimetre fine tuning. Zoom changes only the view.
search_pdf_note: Search PDF text. Select a matching page on the left; matches are highlighted yellow. PDF remains unchanged. Run OCR first for image-only scans.
search_pdf_none: No matches. Run OCR first for scanned pages without a text layer.
E_TEXT_EMPTY: No text found. Run OCR first for scanned pages.
watermark_note: Place a centered watermark across every page. 45° is diagonal, 0° horizontal. Long text is scaled to fit. The original remains unchanged.
number_note: Set the position in the preview. ## is replaced by the page number, e.g. Page ##. Saving applies the settings to all pages.
annotation_note: Enter text. Click on the PDF page to place the note; drag with the left mouse button to move it. Use percentage fields for precise positioning. Saved on the selected page only.
description_signature_image: Insert a signature image and position it with the mouse.
signature_note: Choose an image or visible signature. Click it for a selection frame with four corner handles. Drag inside to move; drag a corner to resize proportionally. Click outside to deselect. Not a digital signature.
E_CANCELLED: Operation cancelled. No output file created.
overlay_auto: Automatic (one template or matching page count)
overlay_single: One template page for all target pages
overlay_note: PDF 1 and PDF 2 above, finished result below. PDF 1 determines page count and page size. Drag in the result to move PDF 2. Empty page selection means all pages.
creator_note: Add text or images. Click to select, drag inside to move, corner handles to resize. Page dimensions in millimeters.
E_EDITOR_BOUNDS: Item is outside the page. Adjust position, size or page format.
E_EDITOR_TEXT_FIT: Text does not fit. Enlarge the text box or reduce the font size.
convert_note: Export PDF as TXT, HTML, ODT or page images. PNG/JPG: numbered pages in a ZIP file, with selectable resolution. ODT includes editable text and page breaks; images and original layout are not reconstructed. Run OCR before TXT/ODT for scanned pages.
pdfa_note: Creates PDF/A-2b using Ghostscript and validates it with veraPDF. The output is saved only after successful conformance validation. Requires Ghostscript and veraPDF CLI (with Java). Interactive forms may lose editability. The original is preserved. Overprint settings are adjusted for the RGB archival copy and annotations made printable; print appearance may change.
E_PDFA_PROFILE: The Ghostscript sRGB colour profile is missing.
E_INPUT_LOCATION: The selected file could not be read. Connect its location or save the PDF locally and select it again.
pdfa_verified: PDF/A-2b conformance confirmed by veraPDF. Saved:
E_PDFA_VALIDATOR: veraPDF is missing. No PDF/A file saved. Set up veraPDF CLI with Java.
E_PDFA_INVALID: Validation failed: veraPDF reports nonconformance with the checked PDF/A profile. No output saved. See the log for details.
E_PDFA_VALIDATION: PDF/A validation could not be completed reliably. No output saved. Check veraPDF and Java.
info_verapdf: Required for conformance validation after PDF/A creation; requires Java.
pdfa_check_note: Validates the selected PDF with veraPDF. The PDF/A variant is detected automatically. Without a valid declaration veraPDF uses PDF/A-1b. The file is unchanged.
pdfa_check_passed: Validation passed: {profile} compliant (veraPDF). The file was not changed.
doc_note: The file is unchanged. Metadata may be absent or inaccurate. Use Validate PDF/A separately to check conformance.
search_label: Search tools – enter a term, for example “PDF/A”
tools_tagline: Almost everything you can do with PDFs.
